bleach-tcg.evidence: Complete eleven-page English Score Entertainment Bleach Trading Card Game core rulebook, Aik Tongtharadol with William Harper/Joshua Morris rules credits. Same Guardian/Mind-Body-Spirit game and 60-card deck as target 28838. Core rules read throughout setup, five-card hand/mulligan, resources, card types, single-character stat attacks/boosting, defense/damage, summoning restrictions, overlays, multiple battlegrounds, queue and glossary. Three additional original Score documents retained unchanged as supporting components: June 25 2007 Advanced Rulings, November 5 2007 Clarifications/Errata, and Guided Walk-Thru. Summary has specific contradictions recorded separately; no full accuracy audit.

battle-of-the-bulge.evidence: Original SPI copyright-1979 Bulge: The Battle for the Ardennes 16 Dec 1944–2 Jan 1945, James Dunnigan/Redmond Simonsen/Eric Smith. Correct named description, distinct from stored Avalon Hill 1965 game; primary BGG 4252 lists the exact alternate title and bridge-supply/VP system, identity correction retained. Complete eight-page scan: all sections 1–16, setup/sequence, movement and road/mechanized rules, bridge interdiction, two combat tables, supply/reinforcements, optional airdrop/surprise, weather/air power, turn-by-turn VP differential, counter section and terrain/combat/weather tables. Original first-page title/contents visually read, main sequence/movement/supply/victory inspected in OCR, complete section/page coverage checked. Table OCR has substantial layout/number errors; original scan is authoritative. No later Decision Games redesign substituted; no summary accuracy certification.

jumbulaya.evidence: Complete original four-page English Jumbulaya instruction sheet, copyright 2008 Legendary Games, retailer Vat19 scan linked by dated 2012 review. Same target BGG 35548 nine-row/five-tile-rack/rearrange-add-trade game and vertical seven-to-nine-tile Jumbulaya; primary BGG description confirms that tile-count goal. All four pages read in OCR; original first and scoring/end pages visually checked. Full setup, all six combinations of actions, no subtraction, word validity/challenges, combo-tile rules, exchange/pass/two-minute turns, all ending conditions, exact score table and bonuses included. OCR misreads eight-tile score as six on page 4; original clearly says eight=12. Original file authoritative. Replaces need for third-party articles, which contain conflicting nine/ten-row and timing descriptions; those remain discovery evidence only. Specific summary tile-count finding recorded separately; no full audit.

devil-s-den.evidence: Original English OSG copyright-1980 Devils Den Rules Folder, David Martin/Leonard Millman Gettysburg tactical game. Both original covers visually checked; full core section 1–22/page coverage verified: company/battalion scale, officers/commands, facing/formations, movement/stacking/ZOC, fire/melee, morale/rally, ammunition/fatigue, artillery, special units, reinforcements, victory, scenarios and reference tables. Core original PDF retained directly, not a local assembly; raw ZIP and historical Study Folder retained as supporting components. OCR table/diagram recognition imperfect; readable original scans authoritative. Later Avalon Hill edition differences and summary accuracy remain unaudited.
